name: Rage
summary: A bidding trick-taking card game where players predict how many tricks they will win each round to score points.
rules_text: Rage uses 110 cards: six colors numbered 0-15 plus action cards. Play is 10 rounds. Round 1 deals 10 cards each, then 9, 8, down to 1. Remaining deck is the trump pile; top card color is trump, flip until a color. Each player bids 0 to hand size for tricks they will win. Left of dealer leads a trick. You must follow lead suit if able, otherwise you may play any card including trump or action. Highest card of lead suit wins unless trump is played, then highest trump wins. Winner leads next. Action cards can only be led or when you cannot follow suit: Out Rage cancels trump for rest of round, Change Rage lets player choose new trump color from pile, Bonus Rage gives winner +5, Mad Rage -5, Wild Rage is declared a color and is highest of that color. Scoring: +1 per trick won, +/-5 for Rage cards, +10 bonus for making exact bid (+5 if bid was 0). Highest total after 10 rounds wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking bidding on tricks won, clear strategic bidding
